title: Encryptex
tagline: Your personal decentralised private cloud storage
description: It Ciphers and De-Ciphers your personal data using just your Metamask wallet and store the Cipher Data in IPFS. Removing use pf protocols like 180 and lightning which provide an Encryption Layer but increases transaction count, depedency. It adds a stack in IPFS since you can now store Encrypted Data in IPFS which is a public archive without worrying about key management, information leak, ease of access. IPFS currently does not have support for Encrypted storage which is solved now by using your wallet.
how_its_made: working with snaps was tricky and the components it has has less flexibility to add custom styling and functions override. We followed and found certain workarounds. The parallel processing of snaps and react part was difficult to handle and we had to  execute them separately.
